chart.title: Gender of the head of government
chart.subtitle: The head of government is the chief officer of the executive branch of their country.
chart.note: This is recorded on December 31 of each year.

Woman head of government (31st December.descriptionShort: Denotes whether the head of government in office on December 31 is a woman.
Woman head of government (31st December.descriptionProcessing:
Equivalent to V-Dem's `v2exfemhog` indicator, but it is modified to reflect the gender of the head of government by the end of the year, December 31. V-Dem, instead, seems to refer to other points during the year.

Affected by change are:

Diango Cissoko: 2012 Mali
Ion Chicu: 2019-2020 Moldova
Joseph Jacques Jean Chrétien: 1993-2002 Canada
KåreIsaachsen Willoch: 1981-1985 Norway
YuriiIvanovych Yekhanurov: 2005 Ukraine

### Data imputation
Unlike most indicators in this dataset, this one is not extended back in time with the data of the historical entity a country was part of. Who led a country is a fact about that country rather than about the power that ruled its territory earlier, so the years before a country appears in V-Dem's data are left empty.
